The first term is $-1.5$ and the common ratio is $-4$.

| $\footnotesize\maroonC{\times (-4)\,\Large\curvearrowright}$ | | $\footnotesize\maroonC{\times (-4)\,\Large\curvearrowright}$ | | $\footnotesize\maroonC{\times (-4)\,\Large\curvearrowright}$ | |
:-: |  :-: | :-: | :-: | :-: | :-: | :-: | :-: | :-:
$-1.5,$ | | $6,$ | | $-24,$ | | $96,...$

This is the recursive formula of $-1.5\,,\,6\,,-24\,,\,96,...$.

$\begin{cases}
d(1)=-1.5
\\\\
d(n)=d(n-1)\cdot(-4)
\end{cases}$
